method: Standard Python bounded SFNT/head/maxp/hhea/hmtx/loca/glyf/cmap/kern byte reads; no installed font parser or rasterizer called.
cmap_and_kerning_selection: Matches inspected owned_ttf_parser 0.25.1 first available Unicode cmap result and first horizontal kern result; ab_glyph absent result maps to zero.
limits: Simple coordinate stream lengths are checked, but point coordinates, component transforms and curves are not expanded.
Declared maxp/head values are retained separately from observed record counts and component graph depth.
Nonempty glyf structure does not establish runtime outline validity, raster bounds or coverage.
No hinted execution, GPOS shaping, coverage, rasterization, Canvas, planner, compiler or GPU execution.
No glyph API caps or actual fixture inventory are selected by this metadata audit.
